messages:
Bea: Hey all, autumn energy. making a cassette-style mixtape for slow paperback reading tonight. low keys, warm textures. ideas?
Carlos: Ooh love. something folky & crackly vinyl-sounding. Nick Drake or Monteverdi-ish acoustic.
Imani: If you want modern warm, try Sufjan Stevens 'Carrie & Lowell' but softer cuts.
Greg: For texture, throw in some field recordings between tracks (rain, cafe clatter). feels cassette-y.
Bea: yes to field recordings. also thinking of sneaking in a short story collection between 2nd and 3rd track. recs?
Carlos: 'Tenth of December' by George Saunders is short, dense, and oddly comforting.
Imani: 'The Paper Menagerie' (Ken Liu) for a beat of melancholy.
MixBot: Generated playlist "Autumn Cassette" - 45 min: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-autumn-cassette
Bea: love it. quick poll to pick the opening vibe: vote :one: :two: or :three:?
PollBot: Poll created by Bea: "Autumn mixtape opener" 
1\ufe0f 1\ufe0f Acoustic folk warmth; 2\ufe0f Lo-fi instrumental with tape hiss; 3\ufe0f Field recording intro (30s) -> gentle song. Ends in 4h.
Carlos: voted :one:.
Imani: voted :three:.
Greg: voted :two:.
Bea: voted :three:. I'll splice the field recording intro and tag you all when it's up.
Carlos: can't wait to read and listen. post reactions after you test the mix :headphones:
Imani: also, cassette label idea: "Page 1 Side A" :label:
